descriptionChirho: Piel intensive: to practice divination, to read omens, to engage in sorcery or augury. All occurrences are Piel stem with identical semantic content across all inflections (perfect, imperfect, infinitive absolute, participle, consecutive imperfect). The multilingual glosses consistently translate as divination/sorcery/augury (adivinar in Spanish, tafsiri/uchawi in Swahili, yatafa''alu in Arabic).
